scripts.setup:local: node scripts/ensure-env.cjs && prisma generate --schema app/db/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema app/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w app/backend" "npm run dev -w app/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w app/backend && npm run build -w app/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run build
